title: Institutional crisis overshadows electoral debate
subtitle: Organizations state that the political crisis is eclipsing campaign proposals
excerpt: With less than a month until the first round, the escalation of the political-institutional crisis has overshadowed the debate on campaign proposals.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
With less than a month to go before the first round of the 2026 elections, the escalation of the political-institutional crisis has overshadowed the debate on campaign proposals and Brazil's structural problems.

Civil society organizations, speaking to Agência Brasil, assessed that the crisis has harmed public discussion and the focus on the issues that truly matter to the electorate.

With information from Agência Brasil.
